additional_info.subject: 0423518 - ID0420166-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP/R2170001564] No backoffice connection. Black screen CRM:02698000055
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Mobility Plus
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R2 170001564
Charger ID/Serial No.:
Rguhag
Problem Description: No backoffice connection on SCB &  Black screen.
Note: Site visit will be required to check the charger as charger is offline on SCB from 18/03/25
Check below points:
a) Internet connection in XF3
b) Ethernet cable connection with XF3 & Switch
c) please carry spare Router when planning for Site visit .
F11-
XF3:8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8 :QTY1
Customer has also mentioned Black screen issue.
a)
Verify Screen Issue:
Check whether the screen is completely black or if it's just a blacklight issue. If there is backlight, refer to the Q feedback below for troubleshooting.
Link:
SI E Q-Feedback Q2302 Sicharge D - HMI Backlight Off and Scrambled Image Due to R... - ID: 109816666 - Industry Support Siemens
b)
Connection Inspection:
Verify all connections between KF1 and PH2 to ensure there are no loose connections.
Confirm the integrity of DPP and USB connections for the OC display and touchscreen functionality.
c) Voltage Check:
Measure the supply voltage and ensure it is delivering a stable 24V.
d) Cable Testing:
Swap the DPP and USB cables with known working ones to rule out cable faults.
e) Firmware Validation:
Ensure the D-Logic controller is updated to the latest firmware.
f) Electrical & Wiring Checks:
Inspect all wiring associated with the HMI and D-Logic controller for potential issues.
please carry Monitor with DPP port to check actual HMI Status
( Connect DP cable between PLC & Monitor : HMI Screen status is coming or not)
g) PCB Handling:
During updates or interventions, ensure the PCB is firmly connected. Handle the flat ribbon cable with care to avoid damage.
If found issue with HMI then HMI needs to be replaced, for HMI MLFB please follow the Q feedback 2302.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
02/07/2025
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
